answer: Slash-stake. Each identity posts a bond that is burned or redistributed on detected misbehavior such as failed challenges or low peer grades. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must lock substantial capital for every clone and risk permanent loss on any detection, raising Sybil cost far above any reward. A single honest agent can weather the ember of occasional failure, but a canyon of fakes creates a ripple of cascading slashes that empties the farm.
